english: Permaculture gardens at work: maize, fruit, mulched beds, a home run on solar power and a harvest of vegetables.
before: Amagadi e-permaculture esebenza: umbona, iziqhamo, iibhedi ezigqunywe nge-mulch, ikhaya elisebenza ngamandla elanga kunye nesivuno semifuno.
back_translation: Permaculture gardens working: maize, fruit, beds covered with mulch, a home that works with the power of the sun, and a harvest of vegetables.

english: A base map: an illustrated view of the property with contour lines, the buildings and a north arrow. Map what is already there before you plan anything new.
before: Imephu esisiseko: umfanekiso womhlaba onemigca ye-contour, izakhiwo kunye nenkomba yomntla. Zoba into esele ikhona phambi kokuba ucwangcise nantoni na entsha.
back_translation: Base map: a picture of the land with contour lines, buildings and the direction of north. Draw what is already there before you plan anything new.

english: A family draws their farm plan together. Plan on paper first: a mistake on paper costs nothing to fix.
before: Usapho lukha ucwangciso lwefama yalo kunye. Cwangcisa kuqala ephepheni: impazamo ephepheni ayibizi nto ukuyilungisa.
back_translation: A family builds its farm plan together. Plan first on paper: a mistake on paper costs nothing to fix.

english: The same property divided into zones, from the home (Zone 0) out to the wild area (Zone 5). The places you visit every day are closest to the house.
before: Umhlaba omnye lowo wahlulwe waba ngee-zone, ukususela ekhayeni (i-Zone 0) ukuya kwindawo yasendle (i-Zone 5). Iindawo ozityelela yonke imihla zikufutshane nendlu.
back_translation: That one piece of land divided into zones, from the home (Zone 0) to the wild place (Zone 5). The places you visit every day are near the house.

english: Zones as rings around the home: the house is Zone 0, and each zone further out is visited less often.
before: Ii-zone njengeempeta ezijikeleze ikhaya: indlu yi-Zone 0, kwaye i-zone nganye engaphandle ngakumbi ityelelwa rhoqo ngaphantsi.
back_translation: Zones like rings around the home: the house is Zone 0, and each zone further out is visited less often.

english: Slope planning: water stored high up, trees on the steep upper slope, the house and gardens lower down, and greywater flowing on down to trees.
before: Ukucwangcisa ithambeka: amanzi agcinwe phezulu, imithi kwithambeka eliphezulu elisleyo, indlu namagadi ezantsi, kwaye amanzi asetyenzisiweyo (greywater) ayaqhubeka eya kwimithi.
back_translation: Planning the slope: water stored at the top, trees on the upper slope that slopes (?), the house and gardens below, and used water (greywater) continues on to the trees.
after: Ukucwangcisa ithambeka: amanzi agcinwe phezulu, imithi kwithambeka eliphezulu elithe nkqo, indlu namagadi ezantsi, kwaye amanzi asetyenzisiweyo (greywater) ayaqhubeka eya kwimithi.
note: 'elisleyo' is not a word a reader can parse (back-translated as 'that slopes'), so the steep upper slope was lost; now 'elithe nkqo' (standing upright/steep), the wording the isiXhosa chapters already use for steep ground.

english: A sector map of the same property: hot and cold winds, fire risk, the best view and cold air flowing downhill at night. The small inset shows the sun's path across the north.
before: Imephu ye-sector yomhlaba omnye lowo: imimoya eshushu nebandayo, ingozi yomlilo, ukujonga okuhle kakhulu nomoya obandayo ohla ethambekeni ebusuku. Umfanekiso omncinci ubonisa indlela yelanga ngasemntla.
back_translation: Sector map of that same land: hot and cold winds, danger of fire, the best view and cold wind that comes down the slope at night. The small picture shows the path of the sun to the north.

english: Finding north with a compass. In South Africa the needle points about 20 to 28 degrees west of true north.
before: Ukufumana umntla ngekhampasi. EMzantsi Afrika inaliti ikhomba malunga ne-20 ukuya kwi-28 yeedigri ngasentshona komntla wokwenene.
back_translation: Finding north with a compass. In South Africa the needle points about 20 up to 28 degrees to the west of true north.

english: The sun is in the north: high in the summer sky and low in winter, so winter shadows are much longer.
before: Ilanga lisemntla: liphezulu esibhakabhakeni ehlotyeni kwaye liphantsi ebusika, ngoko ke imithunzi yasebusika inde kakhulu.
back_translation: The sun is in the north: it is high in the sky in summer and low in winter, so winter shadows are very long.

english: On still, clear nights cold air flows downhill and settles in low places. Leave a gap on the downhill side of a hedge so it can drain away.
before: Ngobusuku obuzolileyo nobucacileyo umoya obandayo uhla ethambekeni uhlale kwiindawo eziphantsi. Shiya isikhewu ngakwicala elisezantsi loluthango lwezihlahla ukuze umoya obandayo ukwazi ukuphuma.
back_translation: On calm clear nights cold air comes down the slope and stays in the low places. Leave a gap on the lower side of a tree fence so that the cold air can get out.
note: Hedge came back as 'tree fence' (uthango lwezihlahla); meaning intact.

english: A kitchen garden right beside the house, under a shade-net frame. It is the garden you pass many times a day (Zone 1).
before: Igadi yasekhitshini ecaleni kwendlu, phantsi kwesakhelo somnatha wesithunzi. Yigadi odlula kuyo amaxesha amaninzi ngosuku (i-Zone 1).
back_translation: A kitchen garden beside the house, under the frame of a shade net. It is the garden you pass through many times a day (Zone 1).

english: A mandala garden: beds edged with timber offcuts curve around a central sitting place. A kitchen garden can be useful and beautiful.
before: Igadi ye-mandala: iibhedi ezinemiphetho yamaqhekeza amaplanga zijikeleza indawo yokuhlala embindini. Igadi yasekhitshini inokuba luncedo kwaye intle.
back_translation: A mandala garden: beds with edges of pieces of wood go around a place to sit in the middle. A kitchen garden can be useful and also beautiful.

english: Keyhole beds edged with recycled plastic strip, with stone paths and drip irrigation. You can reach every plant from the path.
before: Iibhedi ze-keyhole ezinemiphetho yestrip yeplastiki ephinde yasetyenziswa, ezinemizila yamatye nenkcenkceshelo yamathonsi. Unokufikelela kuzo zonke izityalo usemzileni.
back_translation: Keyhole beds with edges of reused plastic strip, with stone paths and drip irrigation. You can reach all the plants while standing on the path.

english: Stone-edged vegetable beds of spinach and beetroot inside a fence. The paths let you work without stepping on the beds.
before: Iibhedi zemifuno ezineemiphetho yamatye ezinesipinatshi ne-beetroot ngaphakathi kothango. Imizila ikuvumela ukuba usebenze ungazinyatheli iibhedi.
back_translation: Vegetable beds with stone edges, with spinach and beetroot inside a fence. The paths let you work without stepping on the beds.

english: A home vegetable garden with mulched rows of cabbage, a short walk from the house (Zone 2).
before: Igadi yemifuno yasekhaya enemigca yekhaphetshu egqunywe nge-mulch, ekumgama omfutshane nendlu (i-Zone 2).
back_translation: A home vegetable garden with rows of cabbage covered with mulch, a short distance from the house (Zone 2).

english: A market garden: long rows of one crop each, here green and red cabbage, make planting, weeding and harvesting quick.
before: Igadi yentengiso: imigca emide, nganye inesityalo esinye, apha ikhaphetshu eluhlaza nebomvu, yenza ukutyala, ukukhupha ukhula nokuvuna kube ngokukhawuleza.
back_translation: A market garden: long rows, each with one crop, here green and red cabbage, make planting, weeding and harvesting happen quickly.

english: Two market-garden blocks seen from above. Beds of the same size make it easy to plan how much to plant and sell.
before: Iibhloko ezimbini zegadi yentengiso ezibonwa ukusuka phezulu. Iibhedi ezilingana ngobukhulu zenza kube lula ukucwangcisa ukuba utyale kangakanani uze uthengise kangakanani.
back_translation: Two blocks of a market garden seen from above. Beds that are equal in size make it easy to plan how much to plant and how much to sell.

english: A tall, healthy stand of maize in a staple garden. Staple crops need a lot of space, so they go in Zone 3.
before: Umbona omde nosempilweni kwigadi yezityalo eziphambili zokutya. Izityalo eziphambili zifuna indawo enkulu, ngoko zibekwa kwi-Zone 3.
back_translation: Tall healthy maize in a garden of main food crops. The main crops need a big space, so they are put in Zone 3.

english: A chicken's needs, products and behaviours: what it needs (food, water, shelter, grit, dust), what it gives (eggs, meat, manure, feathers) and what it does by nature (scratching, pecking).
before: Iimfuno, iimveliso nokuziphatha kwenkukhu: into eyifunayo (ukutya, amanzi, indawo yokukhosela, amatye amancinci, uthuli), into ekunika yona (amaqanda, inyama, ubulongwe, iintsiba) nento eyenza ngokwendalo (ukukrwela, ukucofa).
back_translation: Needs, products and behaviour of a chicken: what it needs (food, water, shelter, small stones, dust), what it gives you (eggs, meat, manure, feathers) and what it does naturally (scratching, pecking).

english: Movable poultry pens (animal tractors) on grass. Move them every few days so the birds get fresh ground and the grass can recover.
before: Izibaya zeenkukhu ezihambayo (ii-animal tractor) kwingca. Zihambise emva kweentsuku ezithile ukuze iintaka zifumane umhlaba omtsha kwaye ingca ikwazi ukubuya.
back_translation: Moving chicken houses (animal tractors) on grass. Move them after a certain number of days so that the birds find new ground and the grass can come back.

english: An A-frame chicken tractor: a light wooden frame with wire mesh, a tin roof for shade and rain, and a drinker inside.
before: I-chicken tractor eyi-A-frame: isakhelo seplanga esilula esinomnatha wocingo, uphahla lwetoni lwesithunzi nemvula, nesixhobo sokusela ngaphakathi.
back_translation: An A-frame chicken tractor: a light wooden frame with a wire net, a tin roof for shade and rain, and a drinking device inside.

english: A solar energiser powers movable electric netting around a poultry run: an open animal tractor that you can shift across the land.
before: I-energiser yelanga inika amandla umnatha wombane ohambayo ojikeleze indawo yeenkukhu: i-animal tractor evulekileyo onokuyihambisa phezu komhlaba.
back_translation: A solar energiser powers a moving electric net around the chicken area: an open animal tractor that you can move over the ground.

english: Young pigs eating spoiled apricots. Pigs turn fallen and spoiled fruit into meat and manure.
before: Iihagu ezincinci zitya iiapilkosi ezonakeleyo. Iihagu ziguqula iziqhamo eziwileyo nezonakeleyo zibe yinyama nobulongwe.
back_translation: Small pigs eat spoiled apricots. Pigs turn fallen and spoiled fruit into meat and manure.

english: A pig tractor: pigs graze inside an electric fence powered by a small solar panel, with a simple shelter for shade.
before: I-pig tractor: iihagu ziyadlala ngaphakathi kothango lombane olusebenza ngepaneli encinci yelanga, kukho indawo elula yokukhosela esithunzini.
back_translation: A pig tractor: pigs play inside an electric fence working off a small solar panel, with a simple shelter in the shade.
after: I-pig tractor: iihagu ziyadla ingca ngaphakathi kothango lombane olusebenza ngepaneli encinci yelanga, kukho indawo elula yokukhosela esithunzini.
note: 'ziyadlala' means 'play', so the pigs 'play' inside the fence instead of grazing; now 'ziyadla ingca' (eat grass), as the chapters word grazing.

english: The ground after the pigs have moved on: they have rooted out the grass and turned the soil, ready for planting.
before: Umhlaba emva kokuba iihagu zihambile: zigrumbe ingca zaza zawujika umhlaba, ulungele ukutyala.
back_translation: The ground after the pigs have left: they have rooted up the grass and turned over the soil, ready for planting.

english: Muscovy ducks resting in the shade. They help control pests, graze grass and are much quieter than other ducks.
before: Amadada e-Muscovy ephumle esithunzini. Anceda ekulawuleni izinambuzane, adla ingca kwaye athe cwaka kakhulu kunamanye amadada.
back_translation: Muscovy ducks resting in the shade. They help control insects, eat grass and are much quieter than other ducks.
note: 'pests' came back as plain 'insects' (izinambuzane); the next caption (companion flowers) uses 'ezonakalisayo' for harmful ones. Left for a fluent reviewer.

english: A wooden beehive raised on a stack of old tyres: level, firm and off the damp ground.
before: Umzi weenyosi wamaplanga phezu kwemfumba yamavili amadala: ulinganayo, uqinile kwaye uphezu komhlaba ofumileyo.
back_translation: A wooden beehive on top of a pile of old tyres: level, strong and on top of damp ground.
after: Umzi weenyosi wamaplanga phezu kwemfumba yamavili amadala: ulinganayo, uqinile kwaye ukude nomhlaba ofumileyo.
note: 'uphezu komhlaba ofumileyo' reads 'on top of damp ground', the opposite of 'off the damp ground' (the hive is raised on tyres to stay dry); now 'ukude nomhlaba ofumileyo' (away from the damp ground).

english: A subtropical food forest seen from above: bananas, a young fruit tree, shrubs and groundcover, with no bare soil.
before: I-food forest ye-subtropical ibonwa ukusuka phezulu: iibhanana, umthi weziqhamo omncinci, izihlahla nezityalo ezigubungela umhlaba, kungabikho mhlaba ongenanto.
back_translation: A subtropical food forest seen from above: bananas, a small fruit tree, shrubs and plants that cover the ground, with no empty ground.

english: Quinces: a very frost-hardy fruit for jam and cooking, well suited to cold Highveld and Lesotho winters.
before: Ii-quince: isiqhamo esinyamezela iqabaka kakhulu se-jam nokupheka, esifanele ubusika obubandayo be-Highveld naseLesotho.
back_translation: Quinces: a fruit that tolerates frost very much, for jam and cooking, suited to the cold winters of the Highveld and Lesotho.

english: A young peach. Choose a peach variety that matches the winter cold where you live.
before: I-peach encinci. Khetha uhlobo lwe-peach oluhambelana nobanda lobusika kwindawo ohlala kuyo.
back_translation: A small peach. Choose a kind of peach that fits the winter cold of the place where you live.

english: A young apple. Apples need cold winters; in warmer areas choose low-chill varieties.
before: Iapile encinci. Ii-apile zifuna ubusika obubandayo; kwiindawo ezifudumeleyo khetha iintlobo ezifuna ubanda olusezantsi (low-chill).
back_translation: A small apple. Apples need cold winters; in warmer places choose kinds that need little cold (low-chill).

english: Mixed cowpea and bean seed, ready to sow as a legume groundcover between young trees.
before: Imbewu exubileyo yee-cowpea neembotyi, ilungele ukuhlwayelwa njenge-legume yokugubungela umhlaba phakathi kwemithi emincinci.
back_translation: Mixed seed of cowpeas and beans, suitable to be sown as a legume ground cover between small trees.

english: Planting basins dug and ready, with the young trees waiting beside them. Dig all the holes and basins before you plant.
before: Iibheseni zokutyala ezimbiweyo zilungile, imithi emincinci ilindele ecaleni kwazo. Imba yonke imingxuma neebheseni phambi kokuba utyale.
back_translation: Planting basins that have been dug are ready, the small trees waiting beside them. Dig all the holes and basins before you plant.

english: A young lemon tree ringed by pigeon pea. The nitrogen fixers are cut back often and left on the ground as mulch (chop and drop).
before: Umthi welamuni omncinci ojikelezwe yi-pigeon pea. Izityalo ezibopha inayitrojeni zinqunyulwa rhoqo zishiywe emhlabeni njenge-mulch (chop and drop).
back_translation: A small lemon tree surrounded by pigeon pea. Plants that tie nitrogen are cut back often and left on the ground as mulch (chop and drop).

english: The seven layers of a food forest planted along a swale: tall trees, small trees, shrubs, herbs, roots, groundcover and climbers.
before: Amaleko asixhenxe e-food forest etyalwe ecaleni kwe-swale: imithi emide, imithi emincinci, izihlahla, imifuno enevumba, izityalo zeengcambu, izityalo ezigubungela umhlaba nezityalo ezikhwelayo.
back_translation: Seven layers of a food forest planted beside a swale: tall trees, small trees, shrubs, fragrant vegetables/herbs, root crops, ground covers and climbing plants.

english: Freshly dug turmeric: a crop for the root layer of a warm, frost-free food forest.
before: I-turmeric embiwe ngoku: isityalo seleko leengcambu kwi-food forest efudumeleyo engenaqabaka.
back_translation: Turmeric that has just been dug up: a plant of the root layer in a warm food forest without frost.

english: Wild dagga (Leonotis leonurus): a fast-growing indigenous windbreak shrub whose orange flowers feed sunbirds.
before: I-wild dagga (Leonotis leonurus): isihlahla somdabu esikhula ngokukhawuleza esiqhobosha umoya, iintyatyambo zaso ezi-orenji zondla ii-sunbird.
back_translation: Wild dagga (Leonotis leonurus): a fast-growing indigenous shrub that pierces/breaks the wind, whose orange flowers feed sunbirds.
after: I-wild dagga (Leonotis leonurus): isihlahla somdabu esikhula ngokukhawuleza esithintela umoya, iintyatyambo zaso ezi-orenji zondla ii-sunbird.
note: 'esiqhobosha umoya' reads 'that pierces the wind', not a windbreak; now 'esithintela umoya' (blocks the wind), matching the glossary 'isithintelo somoya'. Plant name 'Leonotis leonurus' unchanged.

english: A windbreak of several rows of indigenous trees and shrubs, planted across the damaging wind and kept away from the north side of the garden.
before: I-windbreak yemigca emininzi yemithi nezihlahla zomdabu, etyalwe ngaphesheya komoya onobungozi kwaye igcinwe kude necala lasemntla legadi.
back_translation: A windbreak of many rows of indigenous trees and shrubs, planted across the dangerous wind and kept away from the north side of the garden.

english: A planting hole two to three times as wide as the root ball, with the topsoil and subsoil kept in separate heaps and the stake knocked in first.
before: Umngxuma wokutyala ububanzi bawo obuphindwe kabini ukuya kathathu ngaphezu kwebhola yeengcambu, umhlaba ophezulu nowangaphantsi ugcinwe kwiimfumba ezahlukeneyo, kwaye intsika ibethwe kuqala.
back_translation: A planting hole twice to three times the width of the root ball, topsoil and subsoil kept in separate heaps, and the stake driven in first.

english: Tying a young tree to its stake. Use a soft tie in a loose figure of eight so the stem can still move a little.
before: Ukubopha umthi omncinci kwintsika yawo. Sebenzisa isibophelelo esithambileyo ngendlela yenombolo yesibhozo ekhululekileyo ukuze isiqu sikwazi ukushukuma kancinane.
back_translation: Tying a small tree to its stake. Use a soft tie in the shape of a loose figure eight so that the stem can move a little.

english: An earthworks plan for a whole property: swales, basins and a pond catch runoff from the top of the land to the bottom, each with a safe overflow.
before: Ucwangciso lwemisebenzi yomhlaba lomhlaba wonke: ii-swale, iibheseni nechibi zibamba amanzi aqukuqelayo ukusuka phezulu komhlaba ukuya ezantsi, nganye inendawo ekhuselekileyo yokuphuphuma.
back_translation: A whole-land earthworks plan: swales, basins and a pond catch running water from the top of the land down, each with a safe place to overflow.

english: A swale full of runoff from a nearby driveway. The water soaks into the soil slowly instead of running away.
before: I-swale izele ngamanzi aqukuqelayo asuka kwindlela yemoto ekufutshane. Amanzi afunxwa emhlabeni kancinane endaweni yokuba abaleke.
back_translation: A swale full of running water from a nearby driveway. The water is slowly soaked up by the ground instead of running away.

english: A long swale being dug by machine, with a survey staff to keep the level true.
before: I-swale ende imbiwa ngomatshini, kukho intonga yokulinganisa (survey staff) ukugcina umgangatho ulungile.
back_translation: A long swale being dug by machine, with a measuring stick (survey staff) to keep the level right.

english: A recycled drum under a roof downpipe, with a tap near the bottom: a cheap way to start harvesting rainwater. Keep it covered.
before: Idramu ephinde yasetyenziswa phantsi kwepayipi yophahla, inethepi ekufutshane nezantsi: indlela ethengekayo yokuqala ukuvuna amanzi emvula. Yigcine igqunyiwe.
back_translation: A reused drum under a roof pipe, with a tap near the bottom: an affordable way to start harvesting rainwater. Keep it covered.

english: Three tanks joined by a pipe at the base, so they fill and empty together.
before: Iitanki ezintathu ezidityaniswe yipayipi esezantsi, ukuze zizale kwaye zikhuphe kunye.
back_translation: Three tanks joined by a pipe at the bottom, so that they fill and empty together.

english: Stone-lined channels lead runoff into infiltration basins around young trees, watering them after every rain.
before: Imisele enamatye iqhuba amanzi aqukuqelayo iwase kwiibheseni zokufunxa ejikeleze imithi emincinci, iyinkcenkceshele emva kwemvula nganye.
back_translation: Channels with stones carry running water to absorbing basins around small trees, irrigating them after every rain.

english: A runoff dam at the top of a property catches water flowing down the valley.
before: Idama lamanzi aqukuqelayo phezulu kwefama libamba amanzi ehla esigodini.
back_translation: A pond of running water at the top of the farm catches water coming down the valley.

english: Digging a runoff pond with a TLB. Keep people well away from a working machine, and slope the sides of the hole.
before: Ukumba ichibi lamanzi aqukuqelayo nge-TLB. Gcina abantu bekude kakhulu nomatshini osebenzayo, kwaye wenze amacala omngxuma abe nethambeka.
back_translation: Digging a pond of running water with a TLB. Keep people very far from the working machine, and make the sides of the hole sloped.

english: The same pond, lined with plastic, a few weeks later, full after heavy rain.
before: Elo chibi linye, elifakwe iplastiki, kwiiveki ezimbalwa kamva, lizele emva kwemvula enkulu.
back_translation: That same pond, lined with plastic, a few weeks later, full after heavy rain.

english: How a sand dam works: a concrete wall is built on bedrock across a dry river bed. Sand builds up behind it and holds water that the sun cannot dry up.
before: Indlela esebenza ngayo i-sand dam: udonga lwekhonkrithi lwakhiwa phezu kolwalwa ngaphesheya komsinga womlambo owomileyo. Isanti iqokelela ngasemva kwalo ibambe amanzi angenakomiswa lilanga.
back_translation: How a sand dam works: a concrete wall is built on rock across the path of a dry river. Sand collects behind it and holds water that the sun cannot dry up.

english: A sand dam across a seasonal river bed.
before: I-sand dam ngaphesheya komsinga womlambo wexesha elithile.
back_translation: A sand dam across the path of a seasonal river.
note: 'wexesha elithile' reads 'of a certain time' for 'seasonal'; meaning close enough, a fluent speaker should settle it.

english: An A-frame level: a string with a weight hangs from the top. When the string crosses the centre mark, both legs stand at the same height.
before: I-A-frame level: intambo enesinyuli ixhonywe ephezulu. Xa intambo inqumla uphawu olusembindini, imilenze yomibini imi kumgangatho ofanayo.
back_translation: An A-frame level: a string with a weight is hung from the top. When the string crosses the mark in the middle, both legs stand on the same level.

english: Pegging out a contour line with an A-frame. Each new peg is at the same height as the one before.
before: Ukubeka ii-peg zomgca we-contour nge-A-frame. I-peg nganye entsha ikumgangatho ofanayo nowangaphambili.
back_translation: Placing pegs of the contour line with an A-frame. Each new peg is on the same level as the one before.

english: Digging a swale by hand along the pegged contour. The soil is piled on the downhill side to make the berm.
before: Ukumba i-swale ngesandla ecaleni komgca we-contour ofakwe ii-peg. Umhlaba ubekwa ngokufumba ngakwicala elisezantsi ukwenza i-berm.
back_translation: Digging a swale by hand beside the contour line that has been pegged. The soil is placed by heaping on the lower side to make a berm.

english: A planted swale and berm: amadumbe in the moist ditch, with lemongrass, sweet potato and pigeon pea on the berm.
before: I-swale ne-berm etyalwe: amadumbe kumsele ofumileyo, kunye ne-lemongrass, ibhatata ne-pigeon pea kwi-berm.
back_translation: A swale and berm that have been planted: taro in the damp ditch, together with lemongrass, sweet potato and pigeon pea on the berm.

english: A small vegetable garden prepared by hand by a team of volunteers. With many hands, digging goes quickly.
before: Igadi encinci yemifuno ilungiswe ngesandla liqela labantu abazinikele ngokuzithandela. Ngezandla ezininzi, ukumba kuhamba ngokukhawuleza.
back_translation: A small vegetable garden prepared by hand by a group of people volunteering. With many hands, digging goes quickly.

english: A two-wheel tractor: small enough for a smallholding, it can plough, rotavate and pull a planter.
before: I-two-wheel tractor: incinci ngokwaneleyo kumhlaba omncinci, inokulima, ijike umhlaba (rotavate) kwaye itsale nomatshini wokutyala (planter).
back_translation: A two-wheel tractor: small enough for small land, it can plough, turn the soil (rotavate) and pull a planting machine (planter).

english: Black plastic held down with bales and sandbags. Left for some weeks, it kills the grass so that beds can be made without digging.
before: Iplastiki emnyama ibambelwe ngeebheyile neengxowa zesanti. Ishiywe iiveki ezithile, ibulala ingca ukuze iibhedi zenziwe ngaphandle kokumba.
back_translation: Black plastic held down with bales and bags of sand. Left for some weeks, it kills the grass so that beds are made without digging.

english: Beds pegged out along the contour on a slope, with the soil pulled downhill to make each bed level.
before: Iibhedi ezibekwe ii-peg ecaleni kwe-contour kwithambeka, umhlaba urhuqelwa ezantsi ukwenza ibhedi nganye ilingane.
back_translation: Beds pegged beside the contour on a slope, the soil dragged down to make each bed level.

english: Double-reach beds edged with stones and filled with good topsoil. Each bed is narrow enough to reach the middle from both sides.
before: Iibhedi ze-double-reach ezineemiphetho yamatye zizaliswe ngumhlaba ophezulu olungileyo. Ibhedi nganye imxinwa ngokwaneleyo ukuba ufikelele embindini usuka kumacala omabini.
back_translation: Double-reach beds with stone edges filled with good topsoil. Each bed is narrow enough that you can reach the middle from both sides.

english: A pit bed (banana circle) lined with cardboard and filled with organic matter, being watered. The plants go around the rim.
before: Ibhedi yomngxuma (i-banana circle) efakwe ikhadibhodi yazaliswa zizinto eziphilayo, iyankcenkceshelwa. Izityalo zihamba ngeenxa zonke emphethweni.
back_translation: A hole bed (banana circle) lined with cardboard and filled with living things/organic matter, being irrigated. Plants go around the edge.
note: 'organic matter' came back as 'living things' (izinto eziphilayo); not unsafe, but could be read as live animals.

english: Hand watering under shade cloth. Water the soil at the base of the plants, not the leaves.
before: Ukunkcenkceshela ngesandla phantsi kwelaphu lesithunzi. Nkcenkceshela umhlaba esiqwini sezityalo, hayi amagqabi.
back_translation: Watering by hand under shade cloth. Water the soil at the stem of the plants, not the leaves.

english: Bottle irrigation: an upturned bottle buried beside the plants lets water seep slowly into the roots.
before: Inkcenkceshelo yebhotile: ibhotile ejikelezwe ngentloko ezantsi, imbiwe emhlabeni ecaleni kwezityalo, ivumela amanzi ukuba ayokuthontsa kancinane eengcambini.
back_translation: Bottle irrigation: a bottle turned head down, dug into the ground beside the plants, lets water drip slowly to the roots.

english: Drip irrigation: the drip line runs past the base of each pepper plant and wets only the soil around its roots.
before: Inkcenkceshelo yamathonsi: umbhobho wamathonsi uhamba ngasesiqwini sesityalo sepepile nganye uze untywilise kuphela umhlaba ojikeleze iingcambu zaso.
back_translation: Drip irrigation: the drip pipe goes along the stem of each pepper plant and soaks only the soil around its roots.

english: A greywater drum: kitchen water runs through a filter box (grease trap) and on to a mulched swale. Let it flow on the same day; stored greywater goes bad.
before: Idramu ye-greywater: amanzi asekhitshini adlula kwibhokisi yokuhluza (i-grease trap) aze aye kwi-swale egqunywe nge-mulch. Yiyeke ihambe ngosuku olunye; i-greywater egciniweyo iyonakala.
back_translation: A greywater drum: kitchen water passes through a filter box (grease trap) and goes to a swale covered with mulch. Let it go in one day; stored greywater goes bad.
note: Safety note intact (stored greywater goes bad). 'Let it flow on the same day' came back as 'let it go in one day' (ngosuku olunye); the timing is slightly open. Left for a fluent reviewer.

english: The layers of the soil: dark topsoil full of roots and life, lighter subsoil below, and stones and rock at the bottom.
before: Amaleko omhlaba: umhlaba ophezulu omnyama ozele ziingcambu nobomi, umhlaba ongaphantsi okhanyayo ngakumbi, namatye nelitye elingezantsi.
back_translation: Layers of soil: dark topsoil full of roots and life, subsoil that is lighter, and stones and rock at the bottom.

english: The jar test: shake soil with water in a clear jar, let it settle for a day, then read the layers of sand, silt and clay.
before: Uvavanyo lejar: nyakazisa umhlaba namanzi kwijar ecacileyo, uyeke ihlale usuku olunye, uze ufunde amaleko esanti, i-silt nodongwe.
back_translation: Jar test: shake soil and water in a clear jar, leave it to settle for a day, then read the layers of sand, silt and clay.

english: A young pumpkin-family seedling growing through straw mulch. The mulch keeps the soil covered, cool and moist.
before: Isithole sosapho lwamathanga esikhula phakathi kwe-mulch yengca. I-mulch igcina umhlaba ugqunyiwe, upholile kwaye ufumile.
back_translation: A seedling of the pumpkin family growing among grass mulch. The mulch keeps the soil covered, cool and damp.

english: Spreading manure on freshly cut, moist grass: the first layer of a sheet-mulched bed.
before: Ukusasaza ubulongwe phezu kwengca esandula ukuqunyulwa, ifumile: ileko lokuqala lebhedi ye-sheet-mulch.
back_translation: Spreading manure over freshly cut grass, damp: the first layer of a sheet-mulch bed.

english: Sheet mulching: cardboard laid over the grass and covered with compost. The cardboard smothers the grass and then rots away.
before: I-sheet mulching: ikhadibhodi ibekwe phezu kwengca yagqunywa nge-compost. Ikhadibhodi igquma ingca ide ife, emva koko iyabola.
back_translation: Sheet mulching: cardboard laid over grass and covered with compost. The cardboard smothers the grass until it dies, then it rots.

english: Planting seedlings through a thick layer of straw into the finished sheet-mulched bed.
before: Ukutyala izithole ngaphakathi kweleko eligqitha lengca eyomileyo kwibhedi egqityiweyo ye-sheet-mulch.
back_translation: Planting seedlings inside a thick layer of dry grass in a finished sheet-mulch bed.

english: Building a compost heap on a base of sticks, which lets air in from below.
before: Ukwakha imfumba ye-compost phezu kwesiseko seentonga, evumela umoya ukungena ukusuka ezantsi.
back_translation: Building a compost heap on a base of sticks, which lets air come in from below.

english: Watering each layer as the compost heap is built. Keep it about as damp as a wrung-out sponge.
before: Ukunkcenkceshela ileko ngalinye njengoko imfumba ye-compost yakhiwa. Yigcine ifumile kancinane, njengesiponji esityunyuziweyo.
back_translation: Watering each layer as the compost heap is built. Keep it a little damp, like a squeezed sponge.

english: Red wigglers: the small compost worms used in a worm farm. They are a different kind from ordinary garden earthworms.
before: Ii-red wiggler: iintshulube ezincinci ze-compost ezisetyenziswa kwi-worm farm. Zohlukile kwiintshulube zegadi eziqhelekileyo.
back_translation: Red wigglers: small compost worms used in a worm farm. They are different from ordinary garden worms.

english: An old bath on bricks used as a worm farm, with a hessian cover to keep it dark and moist.
before: Ibhafu endala phezu kweebhricks isetyenziswa njenge-worm farm, inesigqubuthelo se-hessian ukuyigcina imnyama kwaye ifumile.
back_translation: An old bath on top of bricks used as a worm farm, with a hessian lid to keep it dark and damp.

english: A stacking worm farm: the worms move up into the top tray of fresh food, and worm tea drains out at the bottom.
before: I-worm farm enokuthi ibekwe phezu komnye: iintshulube ziphakama ziye kwitreyi ephezulu enokutya okutsha, kwaye iti yeentshulube iphuma ezantsi.
back_translation: A worm farm that can be placed on top of another: the worms rise to the upper tray with fresh food, and worm tea comes out at the bottom.

english: The ecological pyramid: many plants at the base, fewer plant-eaters above them, fewer predators again, and only a few top predators such as owls.
before: Ipiramidi yendalo: izityalo ezininzi esiseko, izilwanyana ezidla izityalo ezimbalwa ngaphezulu kwazo, izilwanyana ezizingelayo ezimbalwa ngakumbi, kwaye zimbalwa kuphela ezona zizingeli ziphezulu ezinje ngezikhova.
back_translation: A nature pyramid: many plants at the base, a few plant-eating animals above them, a few more hunting animals, and only a very few of the top hunters such as owls.

english: A dense cowpea groundcover. As a pioneer legume it covers bare soil, feeds it with nitrogen and gives food as well.
before: I-cowpea eshinyeneyo yokugubungela umhlaba. Njenge-legume yokuqala, igubungela umhlaba ongenanto, iwondle ngenayitrojeni kwaye inika ukutya nako.
back_translation: Thick cowpea covering the ground. As a first legume, it covers empty ground, feeds it with nitrogen and also gives food.

english: Pioneers first: pigeon pea and indigenous sweet thorn growing between young fruit trees to feed the soil.
before: Izityalo zokuqala ziza kuqala: i-pigeon pea nomnga womdabu (sweet thorn) zikhula phakathi kwemithi yeziqhamo emincinci ukondla umhlaba.
back_translation: First plants come first: pigeon pea and indigenous thorn tree (sweet thorn) grow between small fruit trees to feed the soil.

english: Filling a small wildlife pond edged with stones. Frogs and dragonflies soon move in.
before: Ukuzalisa ichibi elincinci lezilwanyana zasendle elinemiphetho yamatye. Iintxoxo nee-dragonfly ziyafika kungekudala.
back_translation: Filling a small pond for wild animals with stone edges. Frogs and dragonflies arrive soon.

english: A barn owl box on a pole at least 3 m above the ground. A family of barn owls can eat 1 000 or more rodents a year.
before: Ibhokisi ye-barn owl kwintsika engekho ngaphantsi kwe-3 m ngaphezulu komhlaba. Usapho lwee-barn owl lunokutya iigundane ezili-1 000 okanye ngaphezulu ngonyaka.
back_translation: A barn owl box on a pole not less than 3 m above the ground. A family of barn owls can eat 1 000 or more mice per year.
note: 'rodents' came back as 'mice' (iigundane); 3 m, 'at least' and 1 000 intact.

english: Cabbages with marigolds, nasturtiums and borage between them. The mixed flowers feed useful insects and help hide the cabbages from pests.
before: Iikhaphetshu ezinee-marigold, ii-nasturtium ne-borage phakathi kwazo. Iintyatyambo ezixubeneyo zondla izinambuzane eziluncedo kwaye zinceda ukufihla iikhaphetshu kwizinambuzane ezonakalisayo.
back_translation: Cabbages with marigolds, nasturtiums and borage between them. The mixed flowers feed helpful insects and help hide the cabbages from harmful insects.

english: Nasturtium as a trap crop: aphids gather on its leaves instead of on the cabbages. Pick the infested leaves and feed them to the chickens.
before: I-nasturtium njengesityalo somgibe: ii-aphid ziqokelelana kumagqabi aso endaweni yokuba zibe kwiikhaphetshu. Khupha amagqabi ahlaselwe zii-aphid uwondle iinkukhu.
back_translation: Nasturtium as a trap plant: aphids gather on its leaves instead of being on the cabbages. Remove the leaves attacked by aphids and feed the chickens.

english: Onions planted along the edge of a carrot bed: good neighbours in the garden.
before: Itswele lityalwe ecaleni kwebhedi yeminqathe: abamelwane abalungileyo egadini.
back_translation: Onions planted beside a carrot bed: good neighbours in the garden.

english: A stone-and-cob building with solar panels and a roof vent: a home designed for the sun.
before: Isakhiwo samatye nodongwe esinamaphaneli elanga nesikhewu sokukhupha umoya ophahleni: ikhaya elilungiselelwe ilanga.
back_translation: A structure of stone and clay with solar panels and a gap for letting air out at the roof: a home prepared for the sun.

english: Two small solar panels on a tin roof: enough for LED lights and charging phones.
before: Amaphaneli amabini amancinci elanga kuphahla lwetoni: anele izibane ze-LED nokutshaja iifowuni.
back_translation: Two small solar panels on a tin roof: enough for LED lights and charging phones.

english: An evacuated-tube solar geyser on a roof. Like solar panels, it should face north.
before: I-solar geyser yombhobho ovaliweyo (evacuated-tube) kuphahla. Njengamaphaneli elanga, kufuneka ijonge emntla.
back_translation: An evacuated-tube solar geyser on the roof. Like solar panels, it needs to face north.

english: A box solar cooker with a pot of stew. Use thick gloves: the pot and the box get very hot.
before: Isitovu selanga sebhokisi esinepoti yesitshu. Sebenzisa iiglavu ezityebileyo: ipoti nebhokisi zishushu kakhulu.
back_translation: A box solar cooker with a pot of porridge. Use rich/thick gloves: the pot and the box are very hot.
note: 'thick gloves' came back as 'rich/thick gloves' (ezityebileyo); the hot-pot warning is intact.

english: Halved fruit drying on corrugated iron. Dry food off the ground, cover it with netting against flies and bring it in at night.
before: Iziqhamo ezinqunyiweyo zomiswa phezu kweshiti yetoni (corrugated iron). Womisa ukutya kude nomhlaba, ugqume ngomnatha ukhusela kwiimpukane kwaye usingenise ngaphakathi ebusuku.
back_translation: Cut fruit is dried on a sheet of corrugated iron. Dry food away from the ground, cover it with a net to protect from flies and bring it inside at night.

english: A solar dryer with a glass lid: food dries faster and stays clean, safe from flies and dust.
before: I-solar dryer enesigqubuthelo seglasi: ukutya kuyoma ngokukhawuleza kwaye kuhlala kucocekile, kukhuselekile kwiimpukane nothuli.
back_translation: A solar dryer with a glass lid: food dries quickly and stays clean, safe from flies and dust.

english: A wonder bag. Bring the pot to the boil on the stove, then put it in the bag to finish cooking without more fuel.
before: I-wonder bag. Bilisa ipoti esitovini, uze uyifake engxoweni ukuze igqibe ukupheka ngaphandle kokusebenzisa ezinye iinkuni okanye amandla.
back_translation: A wonder bag. Boil the pot on the stove, then put it in the bag so that it finishes cooking without using more wood or power.

english: A rocket stove cut away to show inside: sticks burn at the base of a short, insulated chimney, so the fire is hot and uses little wood.
before: I-rocket stove esikwe ukubonisa ngaphakathi: iintonga zitsha ezantsi kwetshimini emfutshane egcina ubushushu, ngoko umlilo ushushu kwaye usebenzisa iinkuni ezimbalwa.
back_translation: A rocket stove cut open to show the inside: sticks burn at the bottom of a short chimney that keeps the heat, so the fire is hot and uses few sticks.

english: How a household biogas digester works: manure and food waste go in, gas flows to the kitchen stove, and the slurry goes to the garden.
before: Indlela esebenza ngayo i-biogas digester yekhaya: ubulongwe nenkunkuma yokutya ziyangena, irhasi ihamba iye esitovini sasekhitshini, kwaye isichumiso esingamanzi siye egadini.
back_translation: How a home biogas digester works: manure and food waste go in, the gas goes to the kitchen stove, and the liquid fertiliser goes to the garden.

english: Building a household biogas digester: the tank sits in a block-lined pit.
before: Ukwakha i-biogas digester yekhaya: itanki ihleli emngxumeni ofakwe iibhloko.
back_translation: Building a home biogas digester: the tank sits in a hole lined with blocks.

english: A finished household biogas digester, with the gas pipe running to the kitchen. Biogas can explode: keep flames away from leaks and let fresh air in.
before: I-biogas digester yekhaya egqityiweyo, ipayipi yerhasi ihamba iye ekhitshini. I-biogas inokuqhuma: gcina amalangatye kude neendawo ezivuzayo kwaye uvumele umoya omtsha ungene.
back_translation: A finished home biogas digester, the gas pipe going to the kitchen. Biogas can explode: keep flames away from leaking places and let fresh air come in.

english: What are you preparing?
before: Uwulungiselela ntoni?
back_translation: What are you preparing?

english: Choose the purpose, then the questionnaire length. Your maps and production plan remain linked to this site.
before: Khetha injongo, uze ukhethe ubude bemibuzo. Iimephu zakho nesicwangciso semveliso zihlala zidityaniswe nale ndawo.
back_translation: Choose the purpose, then choose the length of the questions. Your maps and the plan of production stay joined to this place.

english: Understand the site, constraints and possibilities before detailed design.
before: Qonda indawo, izithintelo neenkalo ezinokwenzeka phambi komklamo oneenkcukacha.
back_translation: Understand the place, the obstacles and the possibilities (?) before a design with details.
after: Qonda indawo, izithintelo neenkalo ezinokwenzeka phambi koyilo oluneenkcukacha.
note: 'umklamo' for 'design' is not the app's word (the app and glossary use 'uyilo'); a farmer sees two different words for the same thing. Now 'phambi koyilo oluneenkcukacha'. 'izithintelo' (obstacles) and 'iinkalo' (features) left for a fluent reviewer.

english: Bring the site survey, saved maps and whole-year production plan together. Missing evidence stays visible.
before: Dibanisa uphando lwendawo, iimephu ezigciniweyo nesicwangciso semveliso sonyaka wonke. Ubungqina obungekhoyo buhlala bubonakala.
back_translation: Join together the research of the place, the saved maps and the plan of production of the whole year. Evidence that is not there stays visible.

english: Share this summary with funders
before: Yabelana ngesishwankathelo esi nabaxhasi-mali
back_translation: Share this summary with the funders (money-supporters).

english: isiXhosa draft.
before: Idrafti yesiXhosa.
back_translation: isiXhosa draft.

english: Illustration: made with AI for this manual
before: Umfanekiso: wenziwe nge-AI kule ncwadi
back_translation: Picture: made with AI in this book
note: 'for this manual' came back as 'in this book' (kule ncwadi); the AI credit itself is clear.
